enonce_markdown: Which of the following is an **impact** printer?
corrige_markdown:
### Method reminder

An impact printer forms characters by physically striking an inked ribbon against the paper.

### Solution

The dot-matrix printer strikes a ribbon with pins. Inkjet (sprayed ink), laser (toner and heat) and thermal (heat on special paper) printers do not strike the paper, so they are non-impact printers. **Answer: d.**

enonce_markdown: State **one** advantage of a non-impact printer over a dot-matrix printer, and **one** advantage of a dot-matrix printer over an inkjet printer.
corrige_markdown:
### Method reminder

Compare the printing technology: no striking means quiet and better quality, while striking allows several copies at once.

### Solution

- Non-impact over dot-matrix (any one): quiet; better print quality; faster.
- Dot-matrix over inkjet (any one): can print carbon copies (multi-part forms); a ribbon lasts long so it costs little to run.

enonce_markdown: A shop prints each invoice in three layers (an original and two carbon copies) in a single pass. Which printer is **suitable**?
corrige_markdown:
### Method reminder

Only a printer that strikes the paper can transmit the impact to the layers below.

### Solution

The dot-matrix printer strikes the paper through the ribbon, so the pressure goes through all the layers. Inkjet, laser and thermal printers do not strike the paper, so they cannot make carbon copies. **Answer: b.**

enonce_markdown: How does a **laser** printer produce text on paper?
corrige_markdown:
### Method reminder

To describe a printer, state what forms the marks on the paper: ribbon and pins, liquid ink, or toner.

### Solution

A laser printer uses a laser to draw the page on a drum; toner powder sticks to the drum and is fused onto the paper by heat. Spraying liquid ink describes an inkjet printer, and striking a ribbon or a daisy wheel describes impact printers. **Answer: c.**

choix.texte: A print head strikes an inked ribbon against the paper.
Tiny drops of liquid ink are sprayed through nozzles.
Toner powder is fused onto the paper by heat.
Hammers hit a daisy wheel against the paper.

enonce_markdown: Which statement about the **inkjet** printer is correct?
corrige_markdown:
### Method reminder

Classify the printer first (impact or non-impact), then check its other features.

### Solution

An inkjet printer is a non-impact printer: it sprays tiny drops of ink onto the paper, so it is fairly quiet. It prints in colour, and it cannot make carbon copies because it does not strike the paper. **Answer: a.**

choix.texte: It is a non-impact printer that sprays tiny drops of ink on the paper.
It is an impact printer and it is very noisy.

corrige_markdown:
### Method reminder

Match the job requirement (speed and cost, colour quality, or carbon copies) to the strengths of each printer type.

### Solution

(i) **Laser printer**: it prints text quickly and the cost per page is low for large numbers of copies.

(ii) **Inkjet printer**: it prints colour photographs with good quality at a reasonable price.

(iii) **Dot-matrix printer**: it strikes the paper through a ribbon, so the carbon copies are produced; laser and inkjet printers cannot do this.
